تهتلكون (form VIII)
# تَهْتَلِكُونَ (tahtalikūna) /tah.ta.li.kuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# تُهْتَلَكُونَ (tuhtalakūna) /tuh.ta.la.kuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
